title: Containerization & GPU-Aware Orchestration
subtitle: Package, deploy, and scale AI workloads with Docker and Kubernetes
description: This course teaches students to package, run, and orchestrate AI and Python applications using industry-standard containerization and orchestration tools. Students progress from building Docker images and GPU-enabled containers to deploying, scaling, and monitoring multi-container AI workloads on Kubernetes, including GPU-aware scheduling with the NVIDIA GPU Operator. By the end of the course, students can package a containerized AI application with Helm, provision its infrastructure with Terraform, and monitor it in production with Prometheus and Grafana.
objectives: Explain containerization and build optimized Docker images for AI/Python applications.
Compose and run multi-container AI stacks locally, including GPU-enabled containers via the NVIDIA Container Toolkit.
Deploy and manage AI workloads on Kubernetes using pods, deployments, services, config, and persistent storage.
Configure resource limits, autoscaling, and GPU-aware scheduling with the NVIDIA GPU Operator.
Package, provision, monitor, and troubleshoot containerized AI systems using Helm, Terraform, and Prometheus/Grafana.
slos: Explain containerization and build optimized Docker images for AI/Python applications.

weeks.title: Why Containers for AI: VMs, Images, and the Docker Model
weeks.summary: Introduces containerization concepts, contrasting VMs and container images, and the Docker model for packaging AI apps.

weeks.title: Docker Fundamentals: Running and Managing Containers
weeks.summary: Covers the container lifecycle — running, inspecting, executing into, and managing Docker containers with resource and port controls.

weeks.title: Building AI Container Images with Dockerfiles
weeks.summary: Teaches Dockerfile fundamentals, layer caching, multi-stage builds, and security practices for containerizing AI inference apps.

weeks.title: Docker Compose and Multi-Container AI Applications
weeks.summary: Uses Docker Compose to define and run multi-container AI application stacks locally.

weeks.title: GPU Containers and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit
weeks.summary: Covers running GPU-enabled containers using the NVIDIA Container Toolkit for AI workloads.

weeks.title: Container Registries, Tagging, and Image Security
weeks.summary: Covers pushing images to registries, semantic versioning tag strategy, and scanning images for vulnerabilities with Trivy.

weeks.title: Introduction to Kubernetes: Architecture and kubectl
weeks.summary: Introduces Kubernetes architecture and the kubectl command-line tool for interacting with a cluster.

weeks.title: Kubernetes Workloads: Deployments, Services, and Config
weeks.summary: Covers Kubernetes Deployments, Services, and configuration objects. This week includes the course midterm.

weeks.title: Deploying an AI Inference App to Kubernetes
weeks.summary: Applies Kubernetes fundamentals to deploy a real AI inference application onto a cluster.

weeks.title: Scaling and Resource Management with the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler
weeks.summary: Covers resource requests/limits and autoscaling AI workloads with the Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler.

weeks.title: GPU-Aware Kubernetes with the NVIDIA GPU Operator
weeks.summary: Covers GPU-aware scheduling in Kubernetes using the NVIDIA GPU Operator and device plugin.

weeks.title: Storage, Volumes, and Persistence for AI Models and Data
weeks.summary: Covers Kubernetes storage, volumes, and persistence strategies for AI models and datasets.

weeks.title: Packaging Kubernetes Apps with Helm
weeks.summary: Teaches packaging and deploying Kubernetes applications as reusable charts with Helm.

weeks.title: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
weeks.summary: Introduces Terraform's declarative model — providers, resources, and state — to provision a local Kubernetes cluster and app as code.

weeks.title: Monitoring, Logging, and Troubleshooting Containerized AI
weeks.summary: Covers installing the kube-prometheus-stack, reading GPU metrics via DCGM Exporter, and troubleshooting failing pods with kubectl.

weeks.title: Capstone Project & Course Review
weeks.summary: Students design, build, and present a final capstone project demonstrating mastery of the course's containerization and orchestration outcomes.
